newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money market rates close higher.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money market rates close higher.

text.p: The Pakistani money market rates closed at 20 percent on Saturday after fluctuating between 18 and 19.75 percent in early trading owing to a paucity of funds, dealers said.
At the outset, borrowers picked up funds at 19.75 percent and, as the day progressed, bids gradually slid to 18 percent before closing at 20 percent, a dealer at KASB & Co said.
"The market closed short and banks had to resort to discounting for moderate amounts," the dealer said.
